info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Validation API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Validation API allows financial institutions to validate their correspondent banking relationships efficiently. By leveraging this API, users can ensure that their correspondent bank information is accurate and compliant with regulatory standards. This service is commonly utilized by banking professionals, compliance teams, and financial analysts to maintain robust and up-to-date records of banking partners. The API streamlines the validation process, enhancing operational integrity and reducing the risk of errors in banking transactions.

post.summary: Validate Correspondent Bank for External Agency.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to perform validation checks on the correspondent bank associated with the specified external agency ID (RES-100045). It ensures that the bank details meet the required criteria and are accurate for processing any related transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the details of a correspondent bank directory entry identified by the RES-100045 identifier. It requires specific parameters that must be followed to ensure accurate validation processing.
